class: A pre-trade check that validates the broker's required-margin figure as 'a non-negative amount' blocks every basket that reduces or closes held positions, because the broker reports such a basket with a NEGATIVE required margin (it releases money). Wider shape: a validity range written from entry orders only ('margin is >= 0') turns the risk-reducing order - the exit - into a refused one.
mechanism: Proven live 2026-10-16 15:06 IST: SELL 65 NIFTY26O1923650CE NRML against +65 held, POST /margins/basket?consider_positions=true -> final.total -214.5 (real_order.py fetch: 'kite margin -214.5'); backend/ofo/execution/margin_gate.py required_from_basket_reply raises MarginReplyError for value < 0, so margin_verdict blocks. Unit tests and the 2026-10-16 recordings covered entry baskets only.

first_seen.where: exit of the real 1-lot test order (ADR-097), issue #321
first_seen.evidence: D:/Abhay/Ventures/ofo-kite-ticks/2026-10-16/real-order/fetch.json margin_raw at 15:06; the owner placed the exit (order 261016170858845, SELL 65 @ 3.10 COMPLETE 15:09:52) from a basket built outside the gate.

fix: Built (#321, #338, PR #418, ADR-113): a final.total below 0 counts as 0, never a credit; a basket whose every order closes or reduces a held position (reduces_held_only) is decided on Zerodha's final.total alone, without the ADR-094 BUY top-up, and is built whatever the funds when that figure is 0 or less; a positive figure is compared with funds; entry and mixed baskets keep the top-up. The second sample of the class: a buy-back of a short at a limit above Zerodha's premium (review of PR #418 round 1) was blocked by the top-up at negative funds.

detection.note: The real exit reply (tests/fixtures/kite_replies/margins-basket-exit-150717.json) is the fixture; the buy-back cases derive from it (final.total -500/0/+200, option_premium 650). Not covered: a live closing-basket reply for a buy-back (no short held when recorded); Kite's own placement check stays the backstop.
